description: src/methods/metadata.rs:72-80 and 211-216 contain the same defence-in-depth empty-State guard with hand-edited error messages naming the method. Cookie-cutter copies the canonical mail-client which does the same thing per-method (mailbox.rs:54-57, 156-159, etc.), so this matches workspace shape. Suggested rewrite: a small helper 'fn ensure_non_empty_state(s: &State, who: &'static str) -> Result<(), ClientError>' on SessionClient, called from both metadata_changes and metadata_query_changes. Cuts ~10 lines, removes the per-method-renamed error-message footgun, and improves the audit trail (one place to edit if the validation logic changes). However: this is a canonical-template change. Per crate-jmap-mail-client/AGENTS.md propagation rule, the helper would have to land in mail-client first, then propagate to every extension-client sibling. So this is a deliberately-deferred elegance flag — file the helper-extraction bead against mail-client, not here. Listed in this review as 'taste, no immediate action'.
title: metadata_query / metadata_query_changes share verbatim copy of metadata_changes's sinceState empty-check
